autobiographical_events.summary: the reference agent accepted North after an earlier calibration.

At tick 3 the reference agent faced an underdetermined colour question with no shared criterion and recorded uncertainty rather than an arbitrary choice, proposing a bichromatic rotating-seam variation as a way to expose the missing criterion.

imaginations.title: Rotating radial seam
imaginations.image_or_idea: A circle whose colour is split along a slowly rotating radial seam: blue on one arc, green on the other, so the motif reads differently depending on when and from where it is seen.
imaginations.possible_value: Turns an arbitrary choice into an explicit, observable variable and invites a criterion to be named.
imaginations.test_question: Do viewers report a stable preference once the seam is fixed at a given angle, or does the preference track the angle?

imaginations.title: Two seals, one route
imaginations.image_or_idea: A route map where every fork carries two wax seals: one attesting who drew the map, one attesting whether the drawing instrument was true that day. Travellers keep reading the first seal and walking off the second.
imaginations.possible_value: Makes the authorship/accuracy distinction visible as a design constraint rather than a warning.
imaginations.test_question: Do travellers who see both seals request calibration before departing more often than those who see only the signed recommendation?
